# Mood Meter

> Mood Meter (MoodMeter) is a 100% free, local-first mood tracker and emotional journal for iOS and Android. No ads, no subscriptions, no accounts, and zero cloud tracking—every mood entry and reflection stays strictly on your device.

## Key Facts
- **Developer:** Designed and developed by Srikanth Nandiraju ([srikanth.nandiraju.com](https://srikanth.nandiraju.com/))
- **Price:** $0 forever (no ads, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no locked "Pro" features)
- **Platforms:** iOS (iPhone & iPad via Apple App Store) and Android (phones & tablets via Google Play)
- **Privacy Architecture:** 100% on-device local storage (`AsyncStorage`), offline-ready, no sign-up required, zero third-party analytics or ad SDKs in the app (the website uses Google Analytics)
- **Built-in Emotional Vocabulary:** 220+ expressive mood icons with instant search, plus unlimited user-created **Custom Vibes** (Custom Vibemojis)
- **Mood Logging ("Capture Vibe"):** 1–5 intensity slider with dynamic pulse feedback, voice-typing friendly journal reflections, and flexible date/time backdating
- **Timeline Journal ("History"):** Chronological feed with intensity badges, full-text search across mood names and reflections, and one-tap editing or deletion
- **On-Device Analytics:** Current Vibe Streak, Vibe Power Gauge (*Low Hum*, *Steady*, *High Voltage*, *Supernova*), per-mood contribution donut gauges, 7-day Intensity Trend line chart, top-5 Vibe Distribution, Hourly Activity bars, and 8 key metrics (*Days Tracked*, *Avg Intensity*, *Common Mood*, *7D Average WoW*, *Best Day*, *Worst Day*, *High Intensity %*, *Mood Diversity*)
- **Appearance:** Built-in Light Mode and Dark Mode
